scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem concerns exact block-Jacobi symmetric scaling of rank-one SPD matrices and the three-block energy family (s,s,t); does not establish a universal bound for all block configurations or behavior of the sketched BLOKS preconditioner. Two-block eigenvalue pairing is prior work. Originality carries residual risk from incompletely accessible general block-scaling publications. All proof and numerical verification are internal to this package; no independent audit has occurred.
title: A sharp three-block condition-number deterioration phase diagram for rank-one block Jacobi
